answer: Every epoch the issuer confirms the record is still valid, and a forged or lapsed entry is struck off at once. The gate is fisheries officer patrol log: patrols logged on one river across years of close seasons. One fake record is cheap, but 158 aliases need 158 independent authority-backed records, and the registry check behind each is the price the farm pays. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the inlet signal is public, the walnut check is automatic, and 158 aliases cost 158 times what one real agent costs, with the garden trail open to all.
